item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J01070","case1_error":"Uses the first day's 50 total flowers as its tulip count, replacing 30 and overcounting tulips.","case2_error":"Rescales the already correct 600 half-gallons unnecessarily, then incorrectly evaluates (200/12) × 600 as 300,000.","reason":"The first substitutes a combined count for a category count; the second adds an unjustified scaling step and miscalculates it.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01071","case1_error":"Reduces the required rope length by 25% instead of accounting for the reduced usable length of purchased rope.","case2_error":"Incorrectly evaluates 418 − 342 as 67 instead of 76.","reason":"The first writes an erroneous loss relation; the second numerically miscalculates a correctly written subtraction.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01072","case1_error":"Divides days by remaining words instead of words by days, producing the reciprocal of the requested rate.","case2_error":"Counts only four weekdays and two weekend days in a month, despite assuming four weeks.","reason":"The first reverses a rate ratio; the second uses incorrect day counts. Calendar uncertainty does not justify those counts.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01073","case1_error":"Incorrectly evaluates 30 + 35 + 46 as 101 instead of 111.","case2_error":"Omits Drew's six wrong answers from her question count and incorrectly evaluates 20 + 26 as 30.","reason":"The first has only an addition evaluation error; the second also constructs an incomplete total by excluding answered questions.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01074","case1_error":"Counts the two mother lambs again even though they are already included in the original six.","case2_error":"Omits the four front-yard eggs, adding only the ten and three eggs from the two trees.","reason":"The first double-counts an included subset; the second leaves out a separate required group.","judgment":"different"}]}
